description:
Track and evaluate the performance of your investment portfolio across stocks, cryptocurrencies, and other assets.


* New: PDF and CSV import remember the last used directory per account.
* New: Added a PDF importer for Thurgauer Kantonalbank.
* Improvement: Enhanced PDF importers for DADAT, Sunrise, St.Galler Kantonalbank, comdirect, S Broker, Union Investment, Findependent AG, UmweltBank, and DekaBank.
* Improvement: The right-click menu on a table header now also lists the show/hide column actions.
* Improvement: The attributes page of the edit security dialog can be scrolled.
* Fix: FIFO capital gains now use the exchange rate recorded on the transaction, matching the moving average and cost calculations.
* Fix: Corrected a regression in the calculation of shares held.
